topic: Passive with Verbs with Two Objects
task_instruction: Rewrite each active sentence in the passive voice. Use either object as the subject.
paragraphs: A family is building a LEGO town together. They begin by sharing pieces and plans. {{red:Eva gives her brother a blue building plate.}} {{mask_1}} {{red:Their father shows the children a picture of a tall tower.}} {{mask_2}} {{red:Leo lends his sister a small plastic wheel.}} {{mask_3}} {{red:Their mother tells the family a story about a toy train.}} {{mask_4}}

The family sorts the bricks and decides what to build next. {{red:Grandma sends the children a box of extra bricks.}} {{mask_5}} {{red:Eva teaches Leo a simple way to build a strong wall.}} {{mask_6}} {{red:Their father has given Eva the instruction booklet.}} {{mask_7}} {{red:Leo is handing his sister the red bricks now.}} {{mask_8}}

Soon, the group adds houses, roads, and a station to the town. {{red:Eva will give her brother a small LEGO car.}} {{mask_9}} {{red:Their mother is bringing the builders some snacks.}} {{mask_10}} {{red:Grandma gave the family a new LEGO set last week.}} {{mask_11}} {{red:Leo has promised his sister a place for her garden.}} {{mask_12}}

The builders help each other finish the details. {{red:Their father gave the station a glass roof.}} {{mask_13}} {{red:Eva is lending Leo her green bricks for the park.}} {{mask_14}} {{red:Grandma will tell the children a story about the finished town.}} {{mask_15}} {{red:Leo offered his sister the last yellow brick.}} {{mask_16}}

At the end of the afternoon, the family looks at the completed LEGO town. {{red:Eva has shown her parents the train station.}} {{mask_17}} {{red:Their father will send Grandma a photo of the model.}} {{mask_18}} {{red:Grandma gave the builders some ideas for a bridge.}} {{mask_19}} {{red:The children gave their parents a thank-you card.}} {{mask_20}} The family plans to add more buildings during their next visit.
